summary: Neo, having just woken from a deep sleep in his room where he discovered the physical modifications to his body, is led by Morpheus onto the main deck of the hovercraft. Morpheus explains that the current year is not 1997 but closer to 2197, a revelation that physically knocks the wind from Neo's chest. Morpheus then guides Neo to the Core, a room filled with electronic equipment and ecto-skeleton chairs, and plugs a coaxial line into the jack at the base of Neo's skull to connect him to the Construct.

what_changes.before: Believes the year is 1997 and is confused about his physical state and location.
what_changes.after: Knows the year is much closer to 2197 and is physically connected to the Construct via the jack in his skull.
what_changes.evidence: You believe the year is 1997 when in fact it is much closer to 2197.

what_changes.before: Standing in the main deck, having just discovered the outlet in the base of his skull.
what_changes.after: Seated in an ecto-skeleton chair with a coaxial line plugged into the jack at the back of his neck.
what_changes.evidence: He feels Morpheus guiding a coaxial line into the jack at the back of his neck.

objects_that_matter: jack at the back of his neck

event_hint.one_line: Neo is physically connected to the Construct to begin his education.
